description: Projection (RANGE-2, COL-2, COL-3, COL-6): physical values of every mandatory type, null versus absent, request order, nested columns.

families.projection/column-type: each scalar column of the projection dataset over every row
families.projection/column-combination: several columns: request order, absent versus null, rows across parts
families.projection/absent-and-unknown: columns that no part has (COL-7) and literal dotted names (COL-6)
families.projection/key-column: projecting key returns its physical bytes
families.projection/annotated: physical values of annotated columns (DATE, TIMESTAMP, DECIMAL, STRING)
families.projection/encodings: values from PLAIN_DICTIONARY, DELTA_BINARY_PACKED and DELTA_LENGTH_BYTE_ARRAY pages
families.projection/optional-codec: columns compressed with optional codecs: the values, or unsupported_encoding
families.projection/nested: nested or repeated columns: unsupported_projection. COL-3 permits supporting them, but the runner protocol has no encoding for nested values, so the suite can only accept the rejection; it must never be answered as absent
